title: r1 minor UX: statusline copy refinements — truncation mark cost, offline scoping, phantom parse location, restore-vs-repair alignment
description: Evidence: statusline-data.md:43 ('(cut)' is 5 chars against 10-char fields and glues to values), :22-25 (bare 'offline' on the glance surface can read network-wide; scope lives only in the human text), :13 ('at the reported location' — the static string carries no location), :10 vs :15 (restore vs repair for the same match-the-boundary recovery). Dispositions per item in the lens report; all data-side rewording. Owner: data-engineer. Validator: ux.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: FIX LANDED (commit e61f28e5, statusline-data 0.2.0): truncation_rule states the space set-off (no gluing) — and the mark's cost against narrow fields shrank structurally with the 10-char session field's demotion (#679); offline marker scoped to tracker offline (degraded likewise tracker degraded; schema marker pattern widened for the scope word); malformed diagnostic now templates the parser's reported location and message instead of claiming a location the static string never carried; restore-verb alignment — fix-state-content's human text reads restore-the-content in both the statusline set and the action vocabulary. Round 2 re-verifies (validator: ux).
